_meta.note: Re-check of the Terminal-Bench-Science comparison chart that S270 withheld. The column identity question is settled by the SVG geometry, not by the flattened text: the slope chart has three fixed x positions with axis headers (190 = Terminal-Bench 2.1, 372.5 = Terminal-Bench 3.0, 555 = Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1) and each value sits on one of them as a <circle cx=...>. The TB2.1 mismatch S270 flagged (Fable 5 83.8 vs DB 88.0) is therefore a harness difference — the TB-Science team's own runs — not a mis-read column. The six TB3.0 values are ingested on the existing terminal_bench_3 id with that provenance spelled out; the chart's TB2.1 points are recorded in notes only, so the vendor-sourced TB2.1 rows already in the DB are not overwritten.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 — Life Sciences
benchmarks.description: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 resolution rate within the Life Sciences domain (70-task board; Apache-2.0). Decoded from the announcement's radar chart: value = vertex radius / 4.4, cross-checked against the chart's printed labels. Per-domain rates are not weighted equally, so they need not average to the overall terminal_bench_science score.
